title: The most unlikely Bundesliga winners of all
content: But 22 years ago, they shot up from the second tier to win the Bundesliga at the first go, crushing Bayern Munich on the way. If Otto Rehhagel hoped to carry some of the momentum from his team's march to the 1996-97 Bundesliga 2 title in to a daunting season in Germany's top flight, he was dealt an early blow when the fixture list came out. His revenge was first swift — as an 80th-minute goal from Michael Schjonberg secured the newly-promoted side a shock win on the opening day — then deep, with Kaiserslautern briefly breaking Bayern and Borussia Dortmund's decade-long duopoly with a title win forged on that first day. The side from a town with a population of less than 100,000 in the south-west of Germany drew an average gate of 36,709 to the Fritz Walter stadium in their victorious 2.Bundesliga campaign, with the name of their ground a nod to their rich history —Walter was captain of the West Germany side that pulled off one of the biggest shocks in World Cup history in 1954.

content: # Miracle of Kaiserslautern: The Only Promoted Team to Win the Bundesliga. In Bundesliga history, only one has become the sole story of an unspeakable championship victory by a newly promoted team. FC Kaiserslautern in the 1997-98 season. Among all of Bundesliga history, Kaiserslautern stands alone as the only team to have won the championship right after promotion and become a permanent member of the football legend. Kaiserslautern’s football club received its most significant setback when the team lost to the 2. Before coming to Kaiserslautern, Otto Rehhagel obtained distinction in German football by leading Werder Bremen to win the Bundesliga in 1992. Bundesliga championship with Rehhagel as their manager, leading them to promotions in the Bundesliga. The 1996-97 Bundesliga season introduced Kaiserslautern to an unexpected championship pathway that would create one of German history’s most unimaginable football triumphs. The Bundesliga victory achieved by Kaiserslautern during 1997-98 represents one of the most legendary narratives in football history.
